status.name: Name
status.restart_module_warning: Are you sure you want to restart {name}? The service will be briefly unavailable during the restart.

settings.title: Settings
settings.matrix_server_name_helper: User IDs will look like {id}. The DNS record of {domain} must point to this node.
settings.matrix_server_name_warning_description: The user domain is part of every user ID and room. It cannot change once a user has logged in. The Matrix server domain can still change later.
settings.matrix_server_name_locked_description: Users have already logged in with this domain. Matrix cannot rename it: changing it would need a new empty database.
settings.matrix_server_name_locked: The user domain cannot change once a user has logged in
settings.element_enabled_tooltip: Serve the Element web client on its own domain. When disabled, users connect with the Element mobile or desktop app.
settings.cinny_enabled_tooltip: Serve the Cinny web client on its own domain. When disabled, users connect with another Matrix client.
settings.choose_the_ldap_domain_to_use: Choose the LDAP domain to use
settings.mail_from_format: Must be a valid mail address
settings.nethvoice_auth_url_placeholder_tooltip: The URL used to authenticate users against NethVoice. It should point to the FreePBX External Auth endpoint. If not set, NethVoice mobile app chat integration will be disabled.
settings.federation_tooltip: Let users talk with people on other Matrix servers. Other servers reach this one on port 443 through /.well-known/matrix/server. The Matrix server domain needs a public DNS record and a valid certificate.
settings.federation_certificate_description: Other Matrix servers refuse self-signed certificates. Request a Let's Encrypt certificate or upload a valid one for the Matrix server domain.
settings.federation_whitelist_helper: One server name per line. Leave empty to federate with any server.
settings.turn_enabled_tooltip: For legacy one to one calls, and clients without Element Call, when users are behind NAT. Element Call uses LiveKit and its own TURN relay. Turning it off also removes the stored shared secret.
settings.turn_shared_secret_helper: The static-auth-secret of the TURN server (coturn use-auth-secret mode).
settings.turn_shared_secret_required: The TURN shared secret is required
settings.livekit_enabled_tooltip: Voice and video calls for Element Web, Element X and Cinny voice rooms, one to one and in groups. Media goes through LiveKit on this node.
settings.livekit_ports_helper: Open or forward these ports to this node: {ports}.
settings.livekit_public_address_helper: Leave empty to use the detected address: {address}.
settings.livekit_public_address_none: The public address is detected when you save. Leave empty unless you are behind NAT and detection cannot find it.
settings.livekit_turn_enabled_tooltip: Relays calls for clients whose network blocks the LiveKit ports but allows 3478/udp.
settings.turn_port_in_use: Port 3478 is already used by another application on this node
settings.livekit_port_in_use: Port 7881/tcp or 7882/udp is already used by another application on this node
settings.turn_no_relay_ports: No UDP ports are free on this node for the LiveKit TURN relay
settings.livekit_public_address_number_one_of: Must be an IPv4 or IPv6 address
settings.local_media_lifetime_days: Delete uploaded files not viewed for (days)
settings.remote_media_lifetime_days: Delete cached files from other servers not viewed for (days)
settings.number_min: Must be a whole number, {min} or more
settings.number_range: Must be a whole number between {min} and {max}
settings.search_all_users_tooltip: When enabled, users can find every user who logged in at least once. When disabled, they only find people they already share a room with.
settings.encryption_enabled_helper: When disabled, new rooms and direct chats are created without encryption, and users cannot turn it on. Rooms already encrypted stay encrypted.
